messages:
m1 | B,C,B | 1 | Source says the lab "has not opened the second," so Option 2's "접수하지 않았습니다" (has not received) is a material error, while Option 1's "착수하지 않았습니다" is the closest natural phrasing over Option 3's awkward "개시하지 않았습니다" though it still needs an edit to "열어보지 않았습니다".
m2 | C,C,B | 3 | Source "담당자는 서류를 받으면 접수증만 발급해 주세요" makes the person in charge both receiver and issuer; Option 3 ("When receiving documents, the staff member in charge should issue only a receipt") preserves this, whereas Options 1 and 2 split the agent ("Once/When the person in charge receives... please issue"), though Option 3 still needs an edit for "**Subject:**" and untranslated "운영팀".
m3 | B,B,A,C,C,B,A | 3,7 | Source says the workshop "has a spare pump on loan" that "belongs to the supplier"; Options 3 ("예비 펌프를 대여받았습니다. 이 펌프는 공급업체 소유입니다") and 7 ("예비 펌프를 빌려 두고 있습니다. 이 펌프는 공급업체 소유입니다") capture both holder and owner, whereas Option 4 falsely says the supplier holds it ("공급업체가 갖고 있습니다") and Options 1, 2, and 5 misuse "임대/임차" or "워크숍".
m4 | A,B,C,B,C,A,C | 1,6 | A "납품 명세서" used to verify delivered quantities ("수량은 아직 대조하지 않았습니다") is a "delivery note" (or "statement" in Option 2), not a technical "specification" (Options 3, 5, 7), and Options 1 and 6 avoid the raw "**Subject:**" markdown in Options 2 and 4.

m1 | A, C, B | 1 | "has not opened" is naturally rendered as "착수하지 않았습니다", whereas "접수하지 않았습니다" falsely claims it was not received and "개시하지 않았습니다" is unidiomatic.
m2 | B, B, A | 3 | "the staff member in charge should issue only a receipt" correctly assigns receipt issuance to the staff member, unlike options 1 and 2 where "please issue" misdirects the action.
m3 | B, A, B, C, B, B, B | 2 | "작업장에 임차 중인" and "공급업체 소유" accurately distinguish holding versus ownership, whereas option 4 materially errs with "공급업체가 갖고 있습니다".
m4 | A, B, B, A, B, A, B | 1, 6 | "Delivery Note" correctly identifies the document used for quantity reconciliation, whereas "specification" misidentifies the document type.

m1 | A C A | 1, 3 | "has not opened the second": "착수하지" and "개시하지" mean the lab has not started on it, but "접수하지 않았습니다" says the lab never received it.
m2 | B B A | 3 | "담당자는…접수증만 발급해 주세요": only 3 has the staff member issue the receipt ("the staff member in charge should issue only a receipt"); 1 and 2 shift "please issue" to the reader.
m3 | B A A C B B A | 3, 7 | "has a spare pump on loan… belongs to the supplier": "대여받았습니다" and "빌려 두고 있습니다" are correct; "임대 중" suggests the pump is being rented out; 4's "공급업체가 갖고 있습니다" says the supplier holds it.
m4 | A A B A B A B | 4, 6 | "납품 명세서" is the delivery record, so "delivery note" fits ("reconciled" also fits "대조"), while "specification" names the wrong kind of document.

m1 | B C B | 1 | “착수” comes closest, but both “착수” and “개시” leave the opening status unstated, while “접수하지 않았습니다” reports nonreceipt.
m2 | B B B | 3 | Only 3 clearly assigns receipt issuance to “담당자”, and all three leave “운영팀” untranslated.
m3 | B B A C B B A | 3, 7 | The workshop holds the pump “on loan”, “belongs to the supplier” establishes ownership, and “임대” and “임차” imply rent.
m4 | A B C A C A C | 1, 4, 6 | “납품 명세서” lists delivered quantities, so “delivery note” is precise, “statement” is vague, and “specification” points to requirements.
